title: SuperTag Workspace manifest
description: A Workspace manifest, as supertag apply -f reads it. Its spec is supertag.operator.v1.WorkspaceSpec in supertag/operator/v1/resource.proto; this file is generated from it.

name.description: The resource's name, unique within its kind.

WorkspaceSpec.description: A Workspace's declared fields, and the `spec` of a `Workspace` manifest. Every field is optional, and a manifest may leave out `spec`. A field an earlier apply set that a later manifest omits returns to its default.

source.description: The git remote hosts without a checkout clone. Embedded credentials are refused. Required with `mounts`, and a github.com remote with `pull-request` delivery.

ref.description: The base of each new Session branch. Empty: the checkout's current branch, or the source's default branch in a clone, else `main`.

setup.description: One shell command, on one line, run once in each new Task worktree.

mcp.description: Server names selected from the trusted checkout's `.mcp.json`, without duplicates.

skills.description: Skill names selected from the host checkout, without duplicates.

skillCatalog.description: Skills from a GitHub repository, selected for every Task.

mounts.description: Volumes attached at absolute paths outside the checkout. Paths may not overlap each other, staged files or protected system locations.

delivery.description: How Tasks deliver their changes. Unset: `branch`.

WorkspaceSkillCatalog.description: Skills from a GitHub repository at one revision.

path.description: The directory within it that holds the Skills.

revision.description: The branch, tag or commit to read.

WorkspaceMount.description: One Volume attached to a Workspace's Tasks.

path.description: The absolute path it appears at, outside the checkout.

access.description: How the Task may use it. Unset: `read-only`.

maxBytes.description: The most bytes a copy may hold. Unset: only the 20 GiB limit of every Task Attempt.
